 Right Arrow OutKick John Cena finds next invitee to his namesake WWE showcase at NXT
 The third-generation wrestler got emotional as Cena honored his late father Umaga and the Anoa'i family legacy
 By
 Ryan Gaydos OutKick 
 Published
 November 5, 2026 7:55am EST Comments 
 Facebook
 Twitter 
 Threads
 Flipboard 
 Print 
 Email 
 Add Fox News on Google 
 close Video Roman Reigns and John Cena are the Two Biggest Stars in WWE History 
 Even bigger than Hulk Hogan...
 The John Cena Classic field grew on Wednesday night as the WWE legend announced the second member who will be involved in next month’s pro wrestling showcase.
 John Cena made a rare appearance on WWE’s developmental brand to reveal who the next superstar in the event will be.
 Zilla Fatu.
 CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE 
 This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting partners. If you sign up or place a wager, FOX News may be compensated. This content was created by a team that works independently from the FOX newsroom.
 John Cena enters the ring during NXT at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Fla., on Nov. 4, 2026. (WWE via Getty Images) 
 "This building, to me, means potential. And potential, to me, is opportunity – and it is opportunity season," Cena said before he revealed it was Fatu.
 Fatu is a third-generation pro wrestler who made his debut at NXT earlier this year. He’s the son of the late Umaga and the great nephew of Afa and Sika – known in wrestling as The Wild Samoans. Cena acknowledged his connection to some of the top Samoan wrestling legacy given his own wars with some of the greats in the Anoa’i family tree.
 "I’m here tonight for you. Tonight is very important for me. I kinda feel like an honorary Samoan sometimes," Cena said. "My legacy dates back to run-ins with Rikishi, standing toe-to-toe with The Rock . Facing Roman Reigns. Throwing a few back with the twins, I love my Uces. And being first in line to give Solo (Sikoa) an opportunity. Also, I absolutely loved your dad.
 John Cena and Zilla Fatu speak during NXT at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Fla., on Nov. 4, 2026. (WWE via Getty Images) 
 THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! 
 "For real, your family has done so much for me. It is an honor, tonight, to give to you an opportunity to debut in the John Cena Classic."
 Fatu was a bit emotional as Cena spoke about his family.
 "Thank you John, thank you," he said. "You got me really, really emotional right now. I just want to say I appreciate you. I appreciate the relationship you had with my family. I appreciate the relationship you had with each and everybody in my family but I’m more blessed that you are giving me this opportunity."
 He had a message for everyone tuning into "Monday Night Raw" on Dec. 14.
 "I’m coming for everything."
 John Cena and Zilla Fatu speak during NXT at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Fla., on Nov. 4, 2026. (WWE via Getty Images) 
 Fatu and Cody Rhodes are the first two entrants in the John Cena Classic, which will take place at the ESPN Wide World of Sports Complex in Disney World.
